name: Logo
description: Digitaltableteur brand mark — monochrome (currentColor), square footprint, optional controlled pulse.

ariaRequirements: accessible name via title unless decorative
a11y.reviewedNote: Verified 2026-06-02: role=img/aria-label vs aria-hidden when decorative, focusable=false, non-interactive (no keyboard contract — wrap in link/button to activate). Every mark uses fill=currentColor → maps to system CanvasText in forced colors; the ForcedColors story passes axe. Pulse is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. All Logo tests pass. Re-verified 2026-07-13 for stable promotion: AT snapshots committed for all required stories; `animated` is now a controlled signal (pulses while true) rather than self-hover, driven by SiteHeader's link-hover state. Swapped into SiteHeader (production consumer on every page) with byte-for-byte parity vs the prior inline mark — identical viewBox 0 0 395 323, geometry, dt-logo-pulse keyframes, badge scale, currentColor tokens; verified live in the running app (rest/hover/both themes).

size.description: Square render box in pixels. Default 24.

animated.description:
Pulse the three leading bars while true; a controlled signal driven from the
consumer's hover/focus state (respects prefers-reduced-motion). Default false.

badge.description: Wrap the mark in the brand lime circle (`--logo-background` / `--logo-color`). Default false.

title.description: Accessible name for the mark. Ignored when `decorative`. Default "Digitaltableteur".

decorative.description: When true the mark is purely decorative and removed from the accessibility tree. Default false.

dense: Digitaltableteur brand mark: monochrome currentColor, square footprint, optional link wrapper

usage.description: The brand mark. Monochrome via currentColor so it inherits the surface's ink; square footprint; optionally wraps itself in a home link.
